name: Bronze
description: Unique paint with the addition of an alloy based on secret nano-ingredients. This paint can not be bought for any amount of money, it is given only to players who prove themselves in eSports battles, under signature.
interestingFacts: Players who receive this paint will also receive a unique Spectrum B module with  20% protection against all turrets and mines.
The paint was given out to the bronze medalists of the Inter-Clan Championship.
With the transition of e-sports competitions to StarLadder, the paint began to stand out for 3rd place in the Star Series and acquired resistance of 20% of all turrets.
With the release of new protective coatings on January 29 and February 6, 2015, the paint acquired protection from the Hammer, Vulcan, and mines.
On January 11, 2016, paint was removed from garages from the last bronze medalists of the Star Series - the A&D clan.
On June 4, 2016, the paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the Masters of the Sword tournament - the Synergy clan.
On July 14, 2016, the paint lost its resistance due to the separation of paints into coatings and protective modules.
On December 24, 2016, the paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the Interclan Championship IX tournament - the Eternity clan.
On November 27, 2017, the paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the Interclan Championship X tournament - the international clan.
On November 26, 2018, paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the XI Clan Championship tournament - the Penguins clan.
On November 27, 2019, paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the XII Clan Championship tournament - the Eternity clan.
On November 27, 2020, paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the XIII Clan Championship tournament - the Eternity clan.
On December 19, 2021, paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the {GAME}Sport Season 4 tournament - Team Stepbrothers.
At the moment, Bronze can be earned by placing third in one of the Major eSports Tournaments.

Garage description
Unique paint with the addition of an alloy based on secret nano-ingredients. This paint can not be bought for any amount of money, it is given only to players who prove themselves in eSports battles, under signature.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Players who receive this paint will also receive a unique Spectrum B module with  20% protection against all turrets and mines.
Paint appeared on June 18, 2013 (update 163).
The paint was given out to the bronze medalists of the Inter-Clan Championship.
Until June 3, 2014, the paint had the following protections:
Twins - 40%;
Railgun - 35%;
Ricochet - 35%.
With the transition of e-sports competitions to StarLadder, the paint began to stand out for 3rd place in the Star Series and acquired resistance of 20% of all turrets.
With the release of new protective coatings on January 29 and February 6, 2015, the paint acquired protection from the Hammer, Vulcan, and mines.
On January 11, 2016, paint was removed from garages from the last bronze medalists of the Star Series - the A&D clan.
On June 4, 2016, the paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the Masters of the Sword tournament - the Synergy clan.
On July 14, 2016, the paint lost its resistance due to the separation of paints into coatings and protective modules.
On December 24, 2016, the paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the Interclan Championship IX tournament - the Eternity clan.
On November 27, 2017, the paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the Interclan Championship X tournament - the international clan.
On November 26, 2018, paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the XI Clan Championship tournament - the Penguins clan.
On November 27, 2019, paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the XII Clan Championship tournament - the Eternity clan.
On November 27, 2020, paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the XIII Clan Championship tournament - the Eternity clan.
On December 19, 2021, paint was issued to the bronze medalists of the {GAME}Sport Season 4 tournament - Team Stepbrothers.
At the moment, Bronze can be earned by placing third in one of the Major eSports Tournaments.
